title: Telemetry Events Schema
description: Single telemetry event. Wire format is JSON Lines: one JSON document (validating against TelemetryEvent) per line. Shared telemetry envelope, status, error, and evaluation vocabularies live in telemetry-fragments.schema.json.

TaskStartData.description: Task start carries no data of its own: the task variant is an envelope member on every event of the task, not only on its first one.

TaskEndData.description: Task completion data. It carries the canonical end state, the empty transition list every task-bracket line carries, one task-wide mismatch code from the system-side comparison, and the correctness basis of that comparison. Target and actual values are not members and must not appear. Interaction-step count and step basis stay out.

mismatch_code.description: One task-wide comparison result. The runtime never emits aborted or unclear.

NavigationChangedData.description: Navigation change data: new current field and field group identifiers, plus the canonical transitions the line carries.

FieldRelevanceChangedData.description: Field visibility change data: field ID, group ID, and relevance flag.

FieldCompletionChangedData.description: Field completion change data: field ID, group ID, and completion flag.

FieldGroupRelevanceChangedData.description: Field group visibility change data: group ID and relevance flag.

FieldGroupCompletionChangedData.description: Field group completion change data: group ID and completion flag.

StatusSnapshotData.description: Status snapshot data: navigation state and progress counters.

ValidationErrorClearedData.description: Error data of a validation error that closed. The diagnosis code is fixed for this event: it says which kind of case the line is, and the internal code the channel reported stays inside the channel, where the open-error identity and the blocking/open-group lists need it.

NavigationErrorData.description: Error data of a navigation or form-logic step that failed. The diagnosis code is fixed for this event: it says which kind of case the line is, and the internal code the channel reported stays inside the channel, where the open-error identity and the blocking/open-group lists need it.

SttErrorData.description: Error data of a recognition failure the channel can prove without reading the transcript. The diagnosis code is fixed for this event: it says which kind of case the line is, and the internal code the channel reported stays inside the channel, where the open-error identity and the blocking/open-group lists need it.

ValidationErrorOpenedData.description: Error data of an opened validation error, plus the act that made the line exist. The trigger is required because the producing emitters cannot be told apart afterwards: a state diff opens the same line at load, after a rule became visible, and after a submit attempt. One line stands for one open error, and an open error is at most one per field plus at most one per rule and owning field group: validation reports every rule a field breaks and repeats a shared rule at each field it touches, and counting those reports would measure how the rules are cut rather than how many errors the person is stuck on. A site that reports a state - a submit attempt is made against the whole form - reports every open error of that state even when the channel speaks only one of them, so the measured number stays a property of the form state and not of the prompt. The diagnosis code is fixed for this event: it says which kind of case the line is, and the internal code the channel reported stays inside the channel, where the open-error identity and the blocking/open-group lists need it. See model.md sections 13.1.2.3 and 13.1.2.4.

IntentRecognizedData.description: Voice intent recognition data: stable intent ID.

CommandRecognitionFailedData.description: Command recognition failure data: bounded failure reason and the optional command context.

NoSpeechDetectedData.description: No-speech data: optional field ID when the unanswered turn belonged to a field.

ConversationalPacingSignalType.description: Stable voice-only struggle/fluency signal vocabulary for future adaptive conversational pacing.

ConversationalPacingSignalData.description: Conversational pacing signal data: bounded voice-only struggle/fluency metadata without raw utterance or field values. Optional response_latency_ms is cue-to-speech-start latency and must only be populated from a true speech-onset source.

stt_confidence.description: Speech-to-text confidence from the ASR provider as percentage (0..100), when available.

LanguageDetectedData.description: Conversational STT language signal: detected ISO 639-1 codes from the provider, optional hint codes that were active when the turn was decided, and the optional turn index.

SystemFeedbackData.description: System feedback data: the feedback type and the optional command context that produced it.

FocusChangeData.description: UI focus change data: target field ID.

ValueChangeData.description: Field value change data: field ID and optional STT confidence percentage.

stt_confidence.description: Speech-to-text confidence from the ASR provider as percentage (0..100). Only present for voice input.

ManualStepData.description: Manual step data: exactly one fully determined canonical field or field-group transition, plus an optional bounded technical note.

AmbiguityResolvedData.description: Ambiguity resolution data: ambiguity type, resolution strategy, and user action.

InputModeChangedData.description: Input mode transition data: new mode and trigger (explicit_command, automatic, or field_default).

DestructiveCommandResolvedData.description: Destructive command resolution data: command ID and user confirmation result.

confirmed.description: True if the user confirmed the destructive command.

refractory_blocked.description: True if the command was blocked by the refractory window (spec §5.4.4.4).

BargeInData.description: Barge-in event data: records when user interrupts system prompt with speech input.

interrupted_prompt_id.description: Prompt ID that was interrupted by the barge-in, if identifiable.

WakeWordListenerSetupPhase.description: Normative wake-word listener setup phase vocabulary mirrored from IWakeWordTelemetrySink.

WakeWordListenerSetupEventCode.description: Stable event-code vocabulary for wake-word listener setup telemetry.

WakeWordCaptureLoopPhase.description: Normative wake-word capture-loop retry phase vocabulary mirrored from IWakeWordTelemetrySink.

WakeWordCaptureLoopEventCode.description: Stable event-code vocabulary for wake-word capture-loop telemetry.

WakeWordCaptureLoopData.description: Wake-word capture-loop telemetry data: retry phase, stable event code, and optional exception type.

WakeWordTranscriptionRejectionPhase.description: Normative wake-word transcription rejection phase vocabulary mirrored from IWakeWordTelemetrySink.

WakeWordTranscriptionRejectionEventCode.description: Stable event-code vocabulary for wake-word transcription rejection telemetry.

WakeWordTranscriptionRejectionData.description: Wake-word transcription rejection telemetry data: rejection phase, stable event code, optional failure code, and optional exception type.

WakeStitchPhase.description: Normative wake-stitch outcome vocabulary mirrored from the runtime stitch owner.

WakeStitchEventCode.description: Stable event-code vocabulary for wake-stitch telemetry.

WakeStitchData.description: Wake-stitch telemetry data: outcome phase, stable event code, and transcript length dimensions.

WakeWordActivationStatus.description: Normative wake-word activation result status vocabulary carried by wake miss telemetry.

WakeWordMissPhase.description: Normative wake-word miss phase vocabulary mirrored from IWakeWordTelemetrySink.

WakeWordMissEventCode.description: Stable event-code vocabulary for wake-word miss telemetry.

WakeWordMissData.description: Wake-word miss telemetry data: miss phase, stable event code, activation status, and optional recognition dimensions.

WakeWordActivationPhase.description: Normative wake-word activation phase vocabulary mirrored from IWakeWordTelemetrySink.

WakeWordActivationEventCode.description: Stable event-code vocabulary for wake-word activation telemetry.

WakeWordActivationData.description: Wake-word activation telemetry data: activation phase, stable event code, command-presence flag, and optional transcript dimensions.

WakeWordFallbackPhase.description: Normative wake-word lexical fallback publication phase vocabulary mirrored from IWakeWordTelemetrySink.

WakeWordFallbackEventCode.description: Stable event-code vocabulary for wake-word lexical fallback telemetry.

WakeWordFallbackData.description: Wake-word lexical fallback telemetry data: fallback phase, stable event code, optional reason code, and optional exception type.

TaskStartEvent.description: Event: task begins, establishes telemetry baseline.

TaskEndEvent.description: Event: task completes, records final state and validity.

NavigationChangedEvent.description: Event: navigation between fields, captures new position.

FieldRelevanceChangedEvent.description: Event: field visibility change, records field and group context.

FieldCompletionChangedEvent.description: Event: field completion status change, records transition.

FieldGroupRelevanceChangedEvent.description: Event: field group visibility change, records group transition.

FieldGroupCompletionChangedEvent.description: Event: field group completion change, records transition.

StatusSnapshotEvent.description: Event: captures complete form navigation and progress state.

ValidationErrorOpenedEvent.description: Event: validation error appears, records error details and context.

ValidationErrorClearedEvent.description: Event: validation error resolved, records previously active error.

NavigationErrorEvent.description: Event: navigation or form logic error, records system failure.

SttErrorEvent.description: Event: speech recognition failure, records STT error details.

IntentRecognizedEvent.description: Event: voice intent recognized, records the stable intent ID.

CommandRecognitionFailedEvent.description: Event: a spoken command was not accepted, records the failure reason and optional command context.

NoSpeechDetectedEvent.description: Event: a turn produced no usable transcript, optionally records the field ID.

SystemFeedbackEvent.description: Event: system provides feedback, records type (audio/visual/haptic).

FocusChangeEvent.description: Event: input focus change, records the target field ID.

ValueChangeEvent.description: Event: field value change, records the field ID and optional STT confidence percentage.

ManualStepEvent.description: Event: observer-recorded manual step with exactly one fully determined canonical field or field-group transition and an optional bounded technical note.

AmbiguityResolvedEvent.description: Event: ambiguous input resolved, records type, strategy, and action.

InputModeChangedEvent.description: Event: input mode change, records new mode and trigger.

DestructiveCommandResolvedEvent.description: Event: destructive command (cancel/submit), records confirmation result.

BargeInEvent.description: Event: user interrupts system prompt, records barge-in occurrence.

ConversationalPacingSignalEvent.description: Event: voice-only conversational pacing signal, records bounded struggle/fluency metadata for future adaptive pacing.

LanguageDetectedEvent.description: Event: conversational STT language signal, records detected and hinted language codes for a turn.

WakeWordListenerSetupEvent.description: Event: wake-word listener setup reports setup phases and model inventory dimensions.

WakeWordAcousticDetectionEvent.description: Event: wake-word acoustic detection reports detector outcomes and fallback reasons.

WakeWordCaptureLoopEvent.description: Event: wake-word capture loop reports retry and capture-failure phases.

WakeWordTranscriptionRejectionEvent.description: Event: wake-word transcription worker rejects or dispatches a transcription attempt.

WakeStitchEvent.description: Event: wake-stitch owner reports one stitch outcome with stable phase/code telemetry.

WakeWordMissEvent.description: Event: wake-word miss reports no-match, no-speech, recovery-feedback, and cleanup outcomes.

WakeWordActivationEvent.description: Event: wake-word activation reports lexical activation and post-wake diagnostic dimensions.

WakeWordFallbackEvent.description: Event: wake-word listener publishes or fails to publish lexical fallback state.

TelemetryEventVariants.description: Open union of all telemetry event types. Deliberately not closed: the two shapes below close it, one per direction, and a member added here would otherwise be accepted by both.

TelemetryEvent.description: The sent shape: one variant of the union, without the receipt time. A sender that states record_received_at is refused, because the value would then be the sender's and not the server's measurement.

allOf.description: A task-bound envelope carries the existing evaluation-task ID as session_id. Modeled outside-task diagnostics use the placeholder application A00 and task T00 together and must not carry session_id: their storage key is the event, not a task run. The sent shape also refuses record_received_at.

TelemetryEventRecord.description: The stored shape: the sent shape plus the receipt time the server measured when it accepted the line.

allOf.description: Stored lines keep the same session_id rule as the sent shape and require the server receipt time.
